name: Customer Support
intro: Support reps and success managers who answer customers quickly, solve problems on the first touch and keep accounts happy.

roleDetails.text: Answers customer questions by phone, email and chat, solves problems and logs every case in your help desk.
Onboards new customers, checks in on how they're doing, and works to keep and grow the account.
Troubleshoots product and technical issues, walks customers through fixes and escalates bugs with clear notes.
Supports your internal team with accounts, devices, access and software issues.
Handles written support at volume, with clear, on-brand replies and fast response times.
Tracks orders, handles returns, exchanges and refunds, and keeps customers updated until it's resolved.
